scope: Full decoder layer 0 only; no model generation
native: Blocked AVX2 INT8 GEMM for six linears; down_proj runs niyah_i8_gemm per K=32 block (group-major weights) with C FP64 scaled accumulation; FP32 buffers
quantization: Per output-row weight scale; per-token activations except down_proj g32
limitations: Quantized layer accuracy is measured, not certified
Native RMSNorm/RoPE use C, not earlier assembly functions
Activation quant and FP scale operations stay in C; down_proj g32 blocks are K=32 GEMM calls, not a fused kernel
INT8 dots accumulate INT32; floating reductions use FP64
Benchmarks exclude loading and weight quantization
Canaries cover tested output buffers, not proof of universal memory safety
